calibration_split.purpose: fit one frozen log-affine mapping on calibration output only; retain both raw and fitted outputs

heldout_split.purpose: heldout distance/lateral/yaw/animation frames, never used to fit parameters or revise gates

measurement_acceptance.source: Stage6.5 kf.measurement_distance_std=0.03m; P95 engineering allowance fixed at 3 sigma; not a universal camera accuracy guarantee
measurement_acceptance.missing_visible_master_or_model_depth: unavailable; count explicitly, never replace with renderer depth

freshness.source: Stage6.4 yaw.freshness_timeout_s=0.2; not extended for slow inference

truth_policy: renderer RGB enters detector/depth; renderer depth and actor state are separate posthoc assessment only; no GT target observation
asset_experiment: Gazebo walking actor with source material colors restored; explicit 640x360 image performance ablation; unchanged detector/depth/safety gates
